## Arbitrage Sourcing Pipeline
PlumbersStock category → product UPCs → **one bulk Keepa call** → ROI / margin vs Buy Box minus fees → upsert `arbitrage_leads` → log `sourcing_runs`.

Triggered by the inventory dashboard /arbitrage page (POST webhook, header `x-arbitrage-secret`) or **Manual Run**. Body: `{ category_url, max_products, min_roi_pct, min_profit, prep_cost }`.
Keepa cost ≈ 3 tokens per matched product (1 + 2 for Buy Box). Code lives in github.com/Historfic/inventory-dashboard under `scripts/arbitrage/n8n/code/` — edit there and run `node scripts/arbitrage/n8n/deploy.mjs`.
